name: Persistent_characteristic
definition_en: The Persistent_characteristic is a physiological characteristic or personality trait of the Individual which is conceived of as persisting over time.

name: Age
definition_en: The Age is the length of time the Individual has been alive.  'There is a history of young leftists gaining publicity and buzz.'

name: Ethnicity
definition_en: The Ethnicity is the religious, racial, national, socio-economic or cultural group to which the Individual belongs.

name: Position_qualifier
definition_en: A phrase that indicates more precisely the location in political space of the Individual relative to the center of the region designated by the target.

name: Origin
definition_en: The Origin is the place where the Person was born or lived a salient part of her or his life.

name: Person
definition_en: The human being of a certain age.

name: Persistent_characteristic
definition_en: The Persistent_characteristic is a physiological characteristic or personality trait of the Person which is concieved of as persisting over time.

name: Ethnicity

name: Context_of_acquaintance
definition_en: An expression indicating the context with which the Person is associated.  'Hey look, it's that kid from the restaurant.'

name: Jurisdiction
definition_en: The Jurisdiction is the place where the Person typically resides and by whose Authority he is governed.

name: Authority
definition_en: The politically or religiously legitimated persons who govern the Jurisdiction.

name: Origin
definition_en: The Origin is the place where the Fighter was born or lived a salient part of her or his life.

name: Fighter
definition_en: The Fighter has a military specialty.

name: Persistent_characteristic
definition_en: The Persistent_characteristic is a physiological characteristic or personality trait of the Fighter which is concieved of as persisting over time.

name: Descriptor
definition_en: The Descriptor is a temporary condition of the Fighter.

name: Age
definition_en: The Age is the length of time the Fighter has been alive.

name: Ethnicity
definition_en: The Ethnicity is the religious, racial, national, socio-economic or cultural group to which the Fighter belongs.

name: Context_of_acquaintance
definition_en: An expression indicating the context with which the Fighter is associated.  'Is she the sniper from the movie we saw last night?'

name: Rank
definition_en: The Fighter may have a Rank in the formal or informal military organization to which s/he belongs.  	 'Robin was the highest-ranking gunner at the scene.'

name: Place_of_operation
definition_en: This FE identifies the place where the Fighter is stationed, or primarily operates from.

name: Loyal_side
definition_en: The Fighter belongs to the military of the Loyal_side.

name: Type
definition_en: This FE identifies a more specific Type of specialty that the Fighter has.

name: Compensation
definition_en: The Compensation is the payment that the Fighter receives for performing military service.

name: Contract_basis
definition_en: The Contract_basis describes the conditions of military membership with respect to permanency, time or duration of duty, payment basis, and so on.

name: Military_organization
definition_en: The military organization to which the Fighter belongs.  'My friend is a US Navy engineer.'

name: Origin
definition_en: The Origin is the place where the Person was born or lived a salient part of her or his life.

name: Person
definition_en: The Person is the human being.

name: Persistent_characteristic
definition_en: The Persistent_characteristic is a physiological characteristic or personality trait of the Person which is concieved of as persisting over time.   'What you'd started writing was an action story with a funny villain and a whole lot of hijinks.'

name: Descriptor
definition_en: The Descriptor is a temporary condition of the Person.

name: Age
definition_en: The Age is the length of time the Person has been alive.  'At that time, I was the teenage miscreant who was illegally accessing federal computers.'

name: Ethnicity
definition_en: The Ethnicity is the religious, racial, national, socio-economic or cultural group to which the Person belongs.  'Imagine the photo ops when the Afghan evildoers lay down their arms at your feet.'

name: Context_of_acquaintance
definition_en: An expression indicating the context with which the Person is associated.  'Apparently, another miscreant from the same radio station did the same thing to Robert Esche on Wednesday morning, only it was at 5 am'

name: Field
definition_en: A domain of activity in which the Person exhibits  behavior on which they are judged in terms of its morality.  'After the recent wave of corporate governance shenanigans and the backlash against financial wrongdoers, observers say they are witnessing the first buds of a ?greener? investment focus among professional and individual investors.'

name: Origin
definition_en: The Origin is the place where the Person was born or lived a salient part of her or his life.  In this frame, it is generally incorporated in the lexical item, but may be separately specified as in the following:  'Foreigners from Japan get short shrift around here.'

name: Person
definition_en: The Person is the human being whose Origin is specified.

name: Persistent_characteristic
definition_en: The Persistent_characteristic is a physiological characteristic or personality trait of the Person which is concieved of as persisting over time.  'The swarthy Frenchman appeared at his elbow, smiling.'

name: Descriptor

name: Age
definition_en: The Age is the length of time the Person has been alive.

name: Ethnicity
definition_en: The Ethnicity is the religious, racial, national, socio-economic or cultural group to which the Person belongs.

name: Context_of_acquaintance
definition_en: An expression indicating the context with which the Person is associated.  'Would you believe it? That Frenchman from the subway is back again!'

name: Ethnicity

name: Religion
definition_en: The religious belief system that the Person follows.

name: Known_resident
definition_en: The individual(s) that serve(s) as a reference point for the definition of the Indicated_resident due to the proximity of residences.    'I have no problem with him becoming Madonna's neighbour at all!'

name: Location
definition_en: The place in which the Residents or the Indicated_resident  reside.  'My old house-mate in Berkeley thought it was a hilarious idea.'

name: Indicated_resident
definition_en: A person or group of people defined in terms of the fact that they reside in the proximity of the Known_resident.   'Bill Jankelow is my house-mate.'

name: Age
definition_en: The Age is the length of time the Indicated_resident has been alive.  'Perhaps you know someone who has been doing errands for an elderly neighbour for years, or has performed an extraordinary act of heroism or kindness.'

name: Descriptor
definition_en: The Descriptor is a temporary condition of the Indicated_resident.  'If Western's administration is not careful about how they handle themselves in this situation, they could find themselves with some very angry neighbours on their front doorstep.'

name: Persistent_characteristic
definition_en: The Persistent_characteristic is a physiological characteristic or personality trait of the Indicated_resident which is concieved of as persisting over time.  'We don't know his more irascible neighbours, of course, but we warm to them anyway.'

name: Residents
definition_en: The individuals who reside in proximity to each other.  'Smithers and Kornfeldt are neighbors.'

name: Ethnicity
definition_en: The Ethnicity is the religious, racial, national, socio-economic or cultural group to which the Indicated_resident belongs.  'With the real estate boom, half of my Polish neighbours have sold their properties for a hefty price to young, left-wing, educated professionals. '

name: Ethnicity
