name: Sound_source
definition_en: An entity that is construed as a single point source emitting sound.  'He woke up because of the cries of the crows outside.'

name: Location_of_sound_source
definition_en: The place from which the sound emanates.  'There followed a small silence that was interrupted by a distant cries of caged birds from the interior.'

name: Place
definition_en: The location at which sound is produced. This FE differs from Location_of_sound_source in that it does not highlight the sound's spreading from its source to the perceiver's location, which is usually indicated by the preposition "from".  'The hiss of snakes outside the tent was a constant source of worry.'

name: Internal_cause
definition_en: The noise-making may be prompted by either some outside phenomenon or occurrence, or by an Internal_cause,  that is the mental or emotional state of an animate Sound_source.  'We proceeded despite his stifled cries of pain.'

name: Manner
definition_en: Certain properties of the sound relating to its production, loudness, etc  may be of lexicographic interest if they describe properties of a sounds as such: loudly, shrilly, etc.  'The Brigadier had heard the faint squeak of rats.'

name: Degree
definition_en: Expressions that indicate the loudness of the sound.

name: Explanation
definition_en: This FE idntifies the Explanation that the Sound_source produces the sound. Generally, this is some external stimulus that prompts the Sound_source to make noise.

name: Path
definition_en: The Path along which the sound travels away from the Sound_source.  'The books he wrote later tell how he never forgot the howl of the wolf across the icy field of Otsego on cold winter nights.'

name: Frequency
definition_en: How often the Vocalization event occurs.

name: Speaker
definition_en: This is the person who is characterized as talkative, reticent etc.  It is usually the External Argument:  'Pat has been silent on this issue.'

name: Company
definition_en: The Company in which the Speaker exhibits a certain communicative behavior.  In this frame, Company occurs in PP Complements headed by with:  'Kim was reticent with me about her family.'

name: Text
definition_en: Text is rarely expressed because the quantity of information given is the focus of the frame, rather than the information content. Texts can occur as NP objects, but cannot be either direct quotes or complement clauses.  'Kim gave a hesitant, reticent account.'

name: Topic
definition_en: This FE is the Topic on which much or little information is communicated. Topic is far more frequent than Message in this frame.  'Kim is very talkative about her family and childhood.'

name: Medium
definition_en: Medium is the physical entity or channel used to communicate,  as in other Communication frames.  It is usually a PP Complement headed by in or on.  'Kim is talkative on the phone.'

name: Degree
definition_en: Degree to which the Speaker withholds or does not withhold information and conversation.

name: Manner
definition_en: Manner in which the speaker is reticent or voluble.

name: Judge
definition_en: The individual whose point of view is taken in assigning the judgment denoted by the target.

name: Gambler
definition_en: The person who wages the Asset on a certain Outcome.

name: Place
definition_en: The place where the Gambler makes the wager.

name: Time
definition_en: The time when the Gambler makes the wager.

name: Asset
definition_en: Something desirable possessed by or directly associated with the Gambler which is lost if the Gambler loses the wager.

name: Frequency
definition_en: The Frequency with which the Gambler makes wagers.

name: Purpose
definition_en: The desired action or goal that the Gambler hopes to bring about.  'He wagered all of his remaining money to try and at least break even.'

name: Explanation
definition_en: An Explanation for why the Gambler has put the Asset up in a wager.

name: Iterations
definition_en: The number of times that the Gambler makes wagers.

name: Circumstances
definition_en: The Circumstances indicates the state of affairs under which the Gambler makes a wager.

name: Beneficiary
definition_en: The Gambler intends for his/her actions to benefit Beneficiary in some way.  'They would wager all their money for their closest friends.'

name: Outcome
definition_en: The Gambler predicts that a certain Outcome will hold.

name: Uncertain_situation
definition_en: The Gambler predicts how an Uncertain_situation will resolve.

name: Protagonist
definition_en: The sentient being who cannot proceed with their planned activities until a Salient_entity has arrived or an Expected_event has occurred.  'He politely waited, hat in hand, until he could speak.'

name: Salient_entity
definition_en: A concrete or abstract entity that the Protagonist expects to participate in an Expected_event, typically that of arriving at the Place of the Protagonist.  'In busier times several passengers are waiting for the train.'

name: Time
definition_en: The time period during which the Protagonist is waiting.  'At least 17 ships were waiting yesterday to come up the river.'

name: Place
definition_en: The location in which the Protagonist is waiting.  'Reporters are waiting outside the State Guesthouse for the talks to start .'

name: Duration
definition_en: Duration denotes the length of time from the beginning of the waiting to its end.  'He waited for three hours this night, but no one showed up.'

name: Manner
definition_en: Any description of the waiting event which is not covered by more specific FEs, including general descriptions comparing events (the same way) and salient characteristics of the Protagonist that also affect the action (patiently, anxiously).  'She waited tensely for him to appear'

name: Expected_event
definition_en: The Expected_event is an event that needs to take place or a state that needs to begin to hold before the Protagonist can proceed with their planned activities.  'She did n't wait for a reply, but spelled out the answer herself.' 'Then you have to wait about thirty seconds for there to be enough charge for a second jolt.' ''

name: End_point
definition_en: The point in time, defined either as a clock time or in terms of an event that takes place, at which the Protagonist ends the waiting.   ' I am willing to wait for him until 10 o'clock.'

name: Explanation
definition_en: The Explanation denotes a proposition from which the occurrence of the waiting event logically follows.  'I waited for your brother to give me advice because I wasn't sure I was actually going to do this crazy thing.'

name: Depictive
definition_en: This FE describes the Protagonist as being in some state during the waiting.   'We waited with a smile on our faces and a chortle in our hearts when the race organizers handed out the first weather charts.'

name: Purpose
definition_en: An action that the Protagonist intends to accomplish by waiting.   'Cussing under his breath, he said he went back outside and waited quietly in order to avoid further argument.'

name: Co-participant
definition_en: Co_participant is an entity that participates in a coordinated way in the same event as the primary protagonist, regardless of whether the protagonist, and hence the Co-participant, is more agent- or more undergoer-like.

name: Place
definition_en: This FE identifies the Place where the event occurs.

name: Sleeper
definition_en: This FE identifies the sleeping entity.

name: Time
definition_en: This FE identifies the Time when the event occurs.

name: Sleep_state
definition_en: This describes the state out of which the Sleeper awakens. 'He awoke out of a deep dream.'

name: Manner
definition_en: The Manner in which the Sleeper awakens.

name: Depictive
definition_en: The state of the Sleeper upon waking up. 'Well, sometimes she just wakes up angry.'

name: New_situation
definition_en: The New_situation is the situation the Sleeper finds him or herself in upon awaking.  'I awoke to the sound of the coffeegrinder.'

name: Circumstances
definition_en: Circumstances describe the state of the world (at a particular time and place) which is specifically independent of the event itself and any of its participants.

name: Particular_iteration
definition_en: This FE indicates an instance of the Waking_up event within an iterated series of similar events or states.

name: Explanation
definition_en: The reason for which the Sleeper awakes from the Sleep_state.

name: Frequency
definition_en: This frame element is defined as the number of times an event occurs per some unit of time.

name: Suspect
definition_en: The Suspect is suspected of having committed a crime by the authorities who want the Suspect to enter the criminal process.

name: Charges
definition_en: The Charges are the offenses the Suspect will be accused of committing.

name: Degree
definition_en: This frame element selects some gradable attribute and modifies the expected value for it.

name: Speaker
definition_en: The Speaker produces the Message to alert the Addressee as to possible danger.  'Bill warned me that he would come to the party.'

name: Addressee
definition_en: The Addressee receives the warning from the Speaker.  'When did you warn everyone about the virus?'

name: Message
definition_en: The Message is the communication produced by the Speaker.  'The authorities warned me that my brother had been arrested.'

name: Topic
definition_en: The Topic is a general description of the content of the Message.  'Leroy warned his coworkers about the upcoming audit.'

name: Manner
definition_en: The Manner describes the way in which the Speaker delivers the warning.

name: Means
definition_en: The Means describes the way the Speaker accomplishes the task of warning the Addressee.  'Do you really think you can effectively warn your friends by clanging on bells through the night?'

name: Medium
definition_en: This frame element is the Medium in which the Message is expressed.  'The city will now warn residents in text messages and emails.'

name: Time
definition_en: The time period during which the Speaker warns the Addressee.  'They warned me right away and everything worked out great.'

name: Place
definition_en: The location in which the Speaker warns Addressee.  'She was warned about it in front of her family, but it seemed to have no effect.'

name: Communicative_force
definition_en: This FE indicates the Communicative_force or authority with which the Message is expressed (often denoted by words such as "officially," "formally," "technically," etc.).   'She has yet to receive official warning.'

name: Descriptor
definition_en: A characteristic or description of the telling event or of the Speaker or Addressee.

name: Iterations
definition_en: This FE indicates the number of times an event or state (of the kind denoted by the target in its clause) has taken place or held.  'I've warned you enough times already!'

name: Cognizer
definition_en: The Cognizer is the person who repeatedly changes their mind about which of the Options to choose.  'I went back and forth over whether to post it or not, but the fact is that this blog is as much for you as it is for me.'

name: Explanation
definition_en: The Explanation denotes a proposition from which it logically follows that the Cognizer keeps changing their mind about the Issue.  'The arbitrator wavered on the issue  because of the consequences of such a decision on the worker's employment status.'

name: Options
definition_en: The Options are the alternative courses of action or the alternative physical or concrete entities that the Cognizer can choose from.  'In the late 1890s Carnegie vacillated between wanting to dominate the steel industry and wanting to sell out. '

name: Place
definition_en: This FE identifies the Place where the Cognizer keeps changing their mind between the Options that present themselves.   'Do they know better than us that our dithering at the UN gave Saddam time to hide, destroy, and shuffle his weapons programs?'</def-root >

name: Time
definition_en: This FE denotes the Time interval during which the Cognizer keeps changing their mind about which of the Options to select.  'Here, however, the Romeros had provided some assurance to Ryan's mother of care, although the court later waffled upon how much supervision was guaranteed'

name: Manner
definition_en: Any description of the selecting event which is not covered by more specific FEs, including general descriptions comparing events (the same way) and salient characteristics of the Cognizer that also affect the action.  'American allies like Italy and Greece nervously vacillated on their support for the bombing'

name: Issue
definition_en: The Issue is a question about a course of action or a choice between items.  'Editors go back and forth on a daily basis about what gets in the paper.'

name: Option_1
definition_en: When there is an explicitly separate construal of the Options, Option_1 is the first-mentioned alternative, typically in the form of a from-PP. When it is clear that  the Cognizer actually acted on their choice, Option_1 is the alternative they embraced first before pursuing Option_2.  'You've waffled from one explanation to another.'

name: Option_2
definition_en: When there is an explicitly separate construal of the Options, Option_2 is the second-mentioned alternative, typically in the form of a to-PP. When it is clear that  the Cognizer actually acted on their choice, Option_2 is the alternative they embraced after abandoning Option_1.  'The heroine waffled from one plan to another and all of them were way out in "left field".'

name: Duration
definition_en: In the cases where the Cognizer does not act on their choice, the Duration denotes the length of time from the beginning of the Cognizer's deliberations to the end. In situations where the Cognizer does act on the Options, the Duration denotes the length of the interval during which the Cognizer repeatly changes from one option to the other.  'Jack wavered for about six months.'

name: Frequency
definition_en: This FE describes the number of times within a given period that the Cognizer wavers.

name: Degree
definition_en: The Degree to which the Cognizer wavers.

name: Containing_event
definition_en: This FE denotes an event that occurs or state of affairs that holds at a time that includes the time during which the event or state of affairs reported by the target occurs and of which it is taken to be a part.

name: Circumstances
definition_en: Circumstances describe the state of the world (at a particular time and place) which is specifically independent of the event itself and any of its participants.

name: Person
definition_en: The individual or individuals whose wealthiness is being described. 'Pat and Kim are completely broke at the moment.'

name: Institution
definition_en: A group which has (or lacks) possession of some resource. 'The company is bankrupt.'

name: Degree
definition_en: The degree of wealthiness (or poverty) of the Person or Institution. 'The most affluent landowners never pretended there was a democracy.'

name: Type_of_possession
definition_en: A characterization of the entity (usually money) that the Person (or Institution possesses.  'We are rich in money, but poor Type_of_possession.'

name: Weapon
definition_en: An entity prototypically used by a Wielder to cause damage. 'They used to shoot these long-range rifles with scopes and hit targets a mile away.'

name: Use
definition_en: The type of activity that the Weapon is generally involved in.  Often this can be considered a kind of Type specification also. 'a dueling pistol' 'anti-personnel mines' 'deer rifle'

name: Type
definition_en: This FE indicates what subtype of the general category the Weapon belongs to. 'Most people don't keep bastard swords in their livingrooms.'

name: Material
definition_en: The substance that makes up the Weapon.

name: Wielder
definition_en: The person (or other sentient entity) that is using the Weapon. 'Reluctantly, he slid his guns back into their holsters.'

name: Part
definition_en: This FE identifies a part of the Weapon.  This includes permanent, obligatory parts and mere attachments. 'I bought a rifle with a 2000-yard scope.' 'They practiced on swords with wooden blades first.'

name: Name
definition_en: The term used to refer to an Weapon.  'The sword Wirikidor was inadvertently cursed.'

name: Time_of_creation
definition_en: The time at which a Weapon comes into existence.  'The fourth millennium BC spear has stimulated a lot of controversy.'

name: Creator
definition_en: The individual or group responsible for the creation of the Weapon.  'Colt pistols are, for some reason, considerably more likely to be missold in this fashion.'

name: Descriptor
definition_en: A description or characteristic of the Weapon.  'He prefers to use a heavy bow for long-distance combat.'

name: Wearer
definition_en: The person whose clothing is under discussion. 'Fred was shirtless.'

name: Clothing
definition_en: This FE identifies the Clothing that the Wearer wears. 'Fred was wearing a shirt.'

name: Body_part
definition_en: The body part of the Wearer which is covered by the Clothing.   'She was wearing a glove on one hand.'

name: Degree
definition_en: A characterization of how completely the clothing status holds.  'She was scantily clad -- with just a towel in strategic position.'

name: Manner
definition_en: A characterization of the impression given by the Wearer's clothing status.  ' She was aware that she was being closely observed by the formally dressed staff .'

name: Time
definition_en: The time at or during which the Wearer has the Clothing on.  'By five o'clock, he was wearing the old holey jeans and t-shirt again.'

name: Source
definition_en: NB: This FE will be mapped to Intended_wearing_location  The location that the Wearer exits while wearing the Clothing.  'I just ca n't understand why he doesn't wear his hat out of the house.'

name: Intended_wearing_location
definition_en: The location whose characteristics or state the Clothing of the Wearer was intended to suit.  This FE is only possible with wear.v.  'She wore her purple dress to the party.'

name: Purpose
definition_en: The state-of-affairs that the Wearer wishes to bring about.  'He just wore it to see if it would fit.'

name: Relative_location
definition_en: The location relative to the body of the Wearer that the Clothing occupies.  Note that in many cases, the location is defined relative to other clothing.  'She wore shorts outside her jeans.'

name: Place
definition_en: This FE identifies the Place where the weather occurs.

name: Time
definition_en: This FE identifies the Time when the weather occurs.

name: Specification
definition_en: This FE identifies a further Specification of the weather conditions. 'An icy storm hit the Northeast last night.'

name: Whole
definition_en: The Whole is the larger entity that includes the Part.

name: Part
definition_en: The Part is either a subset or a constituent part of the Whole.

name: Manner
definition_en: Any description of the inclusion event which is not covered by more specific FEs, including secondary effects (quietly, loudly), and general descriptions comparing events (the same way).

name: Time
definition_en: The Time at which the inclusion relation holds.

name: Place
definition_en: The location at which the inclusion relation holds.

name: Cognizer
definition_en: The Cognizer is the individual that is willing to engage in the Activity.  'My mom is very loath to take any drugs without medical supervision.'

name: Activity
definition_en: The Activity is what the Cognizer would do under certain circumstances.  'Does biology really matter more than a willingness to take an active role in a child's life? '

name: Explanation
definition_en: The Explanation denotes a proposition from which the Cognizer's willingness logically follows.   'The other companies would have been unwilling to participate because of the project's high risk.'

name: Place
definition_en: This FE identifies the Place where the Cognizer is willing to engage in the Activity. </def-root >

name: Time
definition_en: This FE identifies the Time when the Cognizer is willing to engage in the Activity.

name: Purpose
definition_en: The state of affairs that the Cognizer wants to achieve by being willing to engage in the Activity.

name: Degree
definition_en: A modifier expressing  the deviation of the willingness from the norm or from the value for another Cognizer.  'If you need help or have any problems, she is extremely willing to work with you.'

name: Frequency
definition_en: This FE denotes the number of times the Cognizer is willing  per some unit of time.

name: Competitor
definition_en: The individual or individuals involved in the Competition.

name: Score
definition_en: A quantity whereby progress is measured during the game, and Rank and Prizes are awarded to the Competitor afterward.

name: Margin
definition_en: The amount by which the Competitor 's and Scores differ.

name: Rank
definition_en: The rank (according to Score) that a Competitor acheives.

name: Prize
definition_en: A socially and/or monetarily significant entity which is given to a Competitor according to Score or Rank.

name: Means
definition_en: An action of the Competitor that results in the outcome of the Competition.

name: Manner
definition_en: Any description of the Competitor which is not covered by more specific FEs, including epistemic modification (probably, presumably, mysteriously), secondary effects (quietly, loudly), and general descriptions comparing events (the same way). It may also indicate salient characteristics of a Competitor that also affect their action (presumptuously, coldly, deliberately, eagerly, carefully).

name: Time
definition_en: When the Competition takes place.

name: Place
definition_en: The location where the Competition takes place.

name: Venue
definition_en: This FE is for the named venue of a competition, particularly when the place has been built for the purpose of a Competition.

name: Particular_iteration
definition_en: Expressions marked with this extra-thematic FE modify a non-iterative use of the target, and indicate that it is conceived as embedded within an iterated series of similar events or states.

name: Competition
definition_en: The event in which the Competitor competes.

name: Explanation
definition_en: The reason why the Competitor wins the Competition.

name: Period_of_iterations
definition_en: The length of time from when winning events began to be repeated to when they stopped.

name: Opponent
definition_en: The individual that the Competitor has been competing against.

name: Circumstances
definition_en: The state of the world when the Competitor wins the Competition.

name: Re-encoding
definition_en: The frame expressed by the target typically corresponds to a Means action within the frame expressed by the Re-encoding, but not necessarily.

name: Result
definition_en: The state-of-affairs that prevails as a result of the Competitor winning the Competition.

name: Iterations
definition_en: The frame element Iterations is used for expressions that indicate the number of times the Competitor wins the Competition.

name: Communicative_force
definition_en: This FE indicates the Communicative_force or authority with which the winning event operates (often denoted by words such as "officially," "formally," "technically," etc.).

name: Event_description
definition_en: This FE applies to appraisals of the event, typically a judgment of its expectedness, or a description of the state-of-affairs introduced by the winning event.

name: Participant
definition_en: The individual or individuals that are engaged or are scheduled to be engaged in an Activity.  'Instead, he was challenged by Neil Gaudry, and withdrew from the race when it appeared that he would not be victorious.'

name: Activity
definition_en: The event that the Participant is engaged in or was scheduled to be engaged in.   ' In any event , in mid-April he withdrew from the contest. '

name: Explanation
definition_en: The Explanation denotes a proposition from which the withdrawing event  logically follows.  'Washington says it withdrew from the agreement because Pyongyang admitted to secretly developing nuclear weapons.'

name: Place
definition_en: This FE identifies the Place where the Participant ends the participation in the Activity.

name: Time
definition_en: This FE identifies the Time when the Participant ends their participation in the Activity.

name: Organization
definition_en: The Organization is an intentionally formed human social group with some definite structure to which the Participant belongs.   'This led to the decision to withdraw from IMF agreements in May 1987 .'

name: Purpose
definition_en: The state-of-affairs that the Participant hopes to bring about by withdrawing

name: Means
definition_en: The act done by the Participant that accomplishes their withdrawal.

name: Medium
definition_en: The document that the Participant uses to communicate their withdrawal.  'In a memorandum dated May 6, they withdrew from the NPT.'

name: Manner
definition_en: A description of the attitude of the Participant which also affects the character of the withdrawal.  'After that, she gladly withdrew from the match.'

name: Ground
definition_en: The Ground serves as a basis for describing the location of the Figure, as inside a region measured outward from the Ground and of a width specified by Distance.  'Our galaxy is just one of thousands that lie within 100 million light years. DNI' 'We allow no civilians within 50 feet of these aircraft.'

name: Figure
definition_en: The Figure is perceived as located relative to a certain Ground location.  'I am within spitting distance of one of the finest farmer's markets in the area.'

name: Distance
definition_en: This  FE identifies the  Distance between the Ground and the borders of the region within which the Figure is located.  'The childhood leukaemia risk is doubled for children living within 100 metres of high voltage.'

name: Sign_1
definition_en: FN: a linguistic unit that carries semantic, phonological or syntactic information. ' In one sense, dog is a hyponym of itself.'

name: Sign_2
definition_en: FN: a linguistic unit  'In one sense, dog is a hyponym of itself.'

name: Signs
definition_en: FN: Linguistic units ' Happy and sad are antonyms.'

name: Circumstances
definition_en: The Circumstances are conditions under which the relationship holds between Sign_1 and Sign_2.

name: Agent
definition_en: The Agent puts effort into reaching Goal.

name: Goal
definition_en: The Goal is what the Agent expends effort to achieve.

name: Outcome
definition_en: The Outcome is the failure or success of an attempt to achieve a Goal.

name: Means
definition_en: This FE identifies the Means by which the effort is done.

name: Degree
definition_en: This FE identifies the Degree to which an attempt occurs.

name: Time
definition_en: This FE identifies the Time when the effort occurs.

name: Depictive
definition_en: The Depictive is a phrase which describes the Agent.

name: Place
definition_en: The place where the work is done.

name: Manner
definition_en: The Manner in which the Agent puts in effort in acheiving the Goal.

name: Duration
definition_en: The time peiod over which the work takes place.

name: Purpose
definition_en: The reason for which the Agent puts effort into achieving the Goal.

name: Particular_iteration
definition_en: Expressions marked with this extra-thematic FE modify a non-iterative use of the target, and indicate that it is conceived as embedded within an iterated series of similar events or states. In addition, most expressions of Particular_iteration indicate which instance of the series is being referred to.

name: Circumstances
definition_en: The state of the world (at a particular time and place) which is independent of the the attempt of the Agent to achieve the Goal.

name: Domain
definition_en: The domain or area within which the work towards the Goal belongs.

name: Salient_entity
definition_en: An entity that is centrally involved in the Goal that the Agent is attempting to acheive.

name: Frequency
definition_en: How often the Agent works.

name: Event_description
definition_en: This FE applies to appraisals of the event, typically a judgment of its expectedness.

name: Descriptor
definition_en: Descriptor covers any characterization or description of the target that is not covered by another more specific FE.

name: Agent
definition_en: The Agent is assigned to a Post to perform a task involving a Salient_entity.

name: Place
definition_en: This FE identifies the place where the Agent staffs the Post.  'Working the front desk at a real estate office is not as fulfilling as it might seem.'

name: Purpose
definition_en: This FE identifies the purpose for which the Agent works at the Post.  'We will be staffing a booth to let everyone know about our upcoming events.'

name: Time
definition_en: This FE identifies the time when the Agent works at the Post.  'Police manned the border from 3 to 5pm.'

name: Means
definition_en: This FE identifies the Means by which the Agent works at the Post.  'Jason manned the booth by handing out brochures and greeting visitors.'

name: Manner
definition_en: Any description of the intentional act which is not covered by more specific FEs, including secondary effects (quietly, loudly), and general descriptions comparing events (the same way). In addition, it may indicate salient characteristics of an Agent that also affect the action (presumptuously, coldly, deliberately, eagerly, carefully).   'Thanks to our volunteers for tirelessly manning the entrance all night.'

name: Frequency
definition_en: The Frequency with which the Agent works in a given period of time.

name: Period_of_iterations
definition_en: The length of time from when the event denoted by the target began to be repeated to when it stopped.

name: Result
definition_en: The Result of working at the Post.

name: Particular_iteration
definition_en: Expressions marked with this extra-thematic FE modify a non-iterative use of the target, and indicate that it is conceived as embedded within an iterated series of similar events or states.

name: Explanation
definition_en: The Explanation denotes a proposition from which the main clause (headed by the target) logically follows. This often means that the Explanation causes the state of affairs expressed by the target, but not in all cases.

name: Event_description
definition_en: This FE gives a description of the working event.

name: Post
definition_en: The Post is a location or station assigned to the Agent where a task or tasks are to be performed.  'Sue was staffing the entrance when everything started to go wrong.'

name: Salient_entity
definition_en: The Salient_entity is centrally involved in the task the Agent is assigned to perform. It is normally located at the Post.  'You'll be working the phones.'
